question: Which among the following corridors was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in October 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **On Tuesday, Prime Minister Narendra Modi i**naugurated the **Mahakal Lok corridor at the Mahakaleshwar temple in Ujjain.**
 
• The corridor is **900 metres long** and has been built at a cost of **Rs 856 crore.**
 
• The first phase of the project was developed at a cost of **Rs 351 crore.**

**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Mahakaleshwar temple is one of the most famous and important Shiva temples in India.**
 
• It is located in the ancient city of Ujjain in the state of** Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• The temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva, who is worshipped there in the form of a lingam, which is believed to be one of the twelve J**yotirlingas in India.**
 
• The temple has a long and rich history, with some parts of it dating back to the **4th century BCE.**
 
• The temple has been destroyed and rebuilt several times throughout its history, with the current structure dating back to the **18th century.**
 
• **The Mahakaleshwar temple** is considered to be one of the most sacred places in Hinduism and attracts thousands of pilgrims every year.
